title: Word size fits the limits
statement: Let $W,N,Q\in\mathbb N$ and let the limits have word bound $w\in\mathbb Z$ and space bound $s\in\mathbb N$. The word size fits these limits, pool size $N$, and stack size $Q$ when $2(2w+2)<2^W$, $2s<2^W$, $4Q<2^W$, and $2N<2^W$, with the natural quantities interpreted as integers in these inequalities.
hypotheses_covered: Limits with word bound $w\in\mathbb Z$ and space bound $s\in\mathbb N$
